title: nan
authors: Lu X.; Chen Z.; Wang L.; Li R.; Zhai C.
key_contribution: Presents a multi-tag RFID tracking system integrated with a strapdown inertial navigation system for drone localization in GPS-denied environments, verified in real scenarios.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
